# UN/LOCODE

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:unLocode`](gmeow-unLocode.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/unLocode>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A UN/LOCODE — a five-character code identifying transport-related locations (ports, airports, rail terminals) worldwide (e.g. 'GBLHR').

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:Geocode`](../classes/gmeow-Geocode.md) -> [`xsd:string`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:unLocode`](gmeow-unLocode.md) from [`gmeow:Geocode`](../classes/gmeow-Geocode.md) to [`xsd:string`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Geocode`](../classes/gmeow-Geocode.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for a UN/LOCODE transport-location code on a [`Geocode`](../classes/gmeow-Geocode.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it for non-transport places where no LOCODE exists.

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:unLocode`](gmeow-unLocode.md) on a [`Geocode`](../classes/gmeow-Geocode.md) whose [`gmeow:geocodeFrame`](gmeow-geocodeFrame.md) is [`gmeow:referenceFrameUNLocode`](../individuals/gmeow-referenceFrameUNLocode.md).

### Examples

- ex:locodeLoc [`gmeow:unLocode`](gmeow-unLocode.md) "GBLHR".
